convert_side.label: 붙이지 않음(원래 조건)
convert_side.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN order_legacy l ON o.order_no = l.order_no WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-01-02 00:00:00' AND o.created_at < '2026-01-02 00:10:00'

convert_side.label: 작은 쪽(order_legacy)에 붙임
convert_side.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN order_legacy l ON o.order_no = CONVERT(l.order_no USING utf8mb4) WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-01-02 00:00:00' AND o.created_at < '2026-01-02 00:10:00'

convert_side.label: 큰 쪽(orders)에 붙임
convert_side.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN order_legacy l ON CONVERT(o.order_no USING latin1) = l.order_no WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-01-02 00:00:00' AND o.created_at < '2026-01-02 00:10:00'

convert_side.label: 스키마를 고침(대조군)
convert_side.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN order_legacy_fixed l ON o.order_no = l.order_no WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-01-02 00:00:00' AND o.created_at < '2026-01-02 00:10:00'

cases.label: 선행 와일드카드
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE buyer_email LIKE '%0@example.com'

cases.label: 뒤집은 컬럼
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE buyer_email_rev LIKE CONCAT(REVERSE('0@example.com'),'%')
